children: Britain's National Energy System Operator has issued an electricity margin notice for Monday evening calling on generators for more power to be available on the system.

"There is no risk to customer electricity supplies, this is not a warning of power cuts, customers do not need to take action and Great Britain's electricity system remains secure," the operator said in a emailed statement.
The margin notice is for 1600-1900 BST.
